Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::createLoanAccount(loanaccountid: Integer,balance: Real,status: LoanAccountStatus[NORMAL|HASPAIDINFULL]): Boolean {
	definition:
		existingAccount: LoanAccount = LoanAccount.allInstance()->any(o: LoanAccount|o.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid),
		found: Boolean = LoanAccount.allInstance()->exists(o: LoanAccount|o.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid),
		created: Boolean = if found = true 
		then false 
		else true 
		endif 
	precondition:
		loanaccountid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		balance.oclIsTypeOf(Real) and
		(status = LoanAccountStatus::NORMAL or
		status = LoanAccountStatus::HASPAIDINFULL) and
		LoanAccount.allInstance()->isUnique(o: LoanAccount|o.LoanAccountID)
	postcondition:
		if created = true 
		then let newLA: LoanAccount in
		newLA.oclIsNew() and
		LoanAccount.allInstance()->includes(newLA) and
		newLA.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid and
		newLA.Balance = balance and
		newLA.Status = status and
		result = created 
		else LoanAccount.allInstance()->includes(existingAccount) and
		result = created 
		endif 
}
